description: Defines the 'cell_scheduler' class which manages resources and scheduling for a cell in a radio network, including handling various scheduling components, event logging, and interactions with UE scheduler.

classes.name: cell_scheduler
classes.description: Manages cell-specific resources and scheduling, handles slot events, errors, and reconfigurations, and interfaces with various scheduling components.

methods.name: cell_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cell scheduler with configuration, message, UE scheduler, and metrics handler.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Handles a slot indication for the cell.

methods.name: handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles an error event for the cell.

methods.name: get_feedback_handler
methods.description: Provides access to the feedback handler.

methods.name: get_positioning_handler
methods.description: Provides access to the positioning handler.

methods.name: get_dl_buffer_state_indication_handler
methods.description: Provides access to the DL buffer state indication handler.

methods.name: get_ue_configurator
methods.description: Provides access to the UE configuration handler.

methods.name: reset_resource_grid
methods.description: Resets the resource grid for a given slot.
